model_role: Interpretive classifier over neutral factual News Observations.
required_preprocessing: Create a neutral factual Event Representation from the observable claim.
Preserve attribution and uncertainty; do not convert allegations into facts.
Do not use GDELT AvgTone or sentiment fields.
Do not infer facts not present in the observation evidence.

output_schema.classification_note: short rationale tied only to observable facts

scoring_rules: Scores represent the likely emotional character of the information state, not measured public opinion.
Primary emotion is the highest-scoring state.
Secondary emotion is the second-highest distinct state.
Intensity reflects emotional force/severity of the observation.
Confidence reflects certainty that the selected emotional interpretation fits the observation.
No aesthetic feedback from color or rendered mosaic.
audit_rules: Store input hash and output hash per observation.
No manual post-hoc alteration for visual appearance.
Reclassification requires a new protocol/model version and a new manifest.
color_access: DENIED during classification; v0.4 may only consume frozen emotion outputs later.
